project: Wuxia Life P80 Renown Endgame Design-First Contract
description: Design-first contract for jianghu_renown_sage endgame / final legacy stage (60+). Define endgame direction, 3 branches (per late-life), contract, validation shape, and GO/NO-GO assessment. Must be LIGHTWEIGHT: 1 echo event + expression updates only if GO.

userStories.title: Audit renown endgame prerequisites
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a prerequisite audit for the renown endgame stage so P80 starts from the real gating surfaces and not from assumptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory all renown route flags, markers, events, expressions (bridge + entry + on-ramp + pressure + payoff + late-life)
Document 3 late-life branch state differences (stats + flags + identity)
Identify what exists before endgame and what can be reused
Assess reuse potential of existing P19 endgame echo system
Output docs/test-reports/p80-renown-endgame-prerequisite-audit.md
No runtime behavior changes
userStories.notes: Complete: 16 flags, 7 events, 7 expression surfaces inventoried; 3 late-life branches documented; P19 reuse assessed; 0 runtime changes

userStories.title: Lock P80 scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P80 stays design-first and does not slip into partial implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Define P80 scope: gap audit, direction design, endgame contract, proof shape
Define allowed layers: docs, contract, targeted proof planning
Define forbidden items: runtime wiring, new framework, bulk content wave, second route, multi-event arc
Define lightweight constraint: max 1 echo event + expression updates
Output docs/test-reports/p80-renown-endgame-scope-contract.md
userStories.notes: Complete: 7 allowed layers, 13 forbidden items, lightweight constraint (1 echo + expression only), 4 scope guardrails, GO/NO-GO criteria, rollback strategy, P80/P81 boundary

userStories.title: Design endgame direction (GO / NO-GO assessment)
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a clear assessment of whether renown endgame is worth doing, and if so, what direction it takes.
acceptanceCriteria: Assess whether endgame is needed after late-life: does late-life already provide sufficient closure?
If GO: define endgame core positioning — life review echo? legacy finalization? natural death culmination?
If NO-GO: define stopping point (late-life as renown route end) and rationale
Determine whether 3 late-life branches need distinct endgames or unified echo
Define essential difference between endgame and late-life (not 'more content' but 'final culmination feel')
Document conclusion in design document
userStories.notes: CONDITIONAL_GO: Legacy Echo (身后名之声) — 江湖如何记住你. 3 distinct variants (one per late-life branch). Perspective shift: first-person life → third-person memory. Clear distinction from late-life and P19. 0 runtime changes.

userStories.title: Design three endgame branches (if GO)
userStories.description: As a designer, I want three distinct endgame branches (one per late-life branch) so renown endgame leverages the 3-branch structure for meaningful differentiation — if endgame is worth doing.
acceptanceCriteria: Design Branch A (Burnout / 油尽灯枯) endgame: core narrative + trigger + player experience
Design Branch B (Lone Wolf / 逍遥自在) endgame: core narrative + trigger + player experience
Design Branch C (Mentor / 传承授业) endgame: core narrative + trigger + player experience
Three branches have meaningfully different expressions, not reskinned
Each branch has tavern-born flavor adaptation
Define endgame as single echo event vs choice event (recommend single auto echo with 3 variants)
If NO-GO, mark as skipped with rationale
Document conclusion in design document
userStories.notes: Complete: 3 branches designed — 叹 (bittersweet legend) / 遥 (distant legend) / 传 (living legend). Single auto echo event with 3 variants. All meaningfully different. All tavern-born flavored. Lightweight compliant. 0 runtime changes.

userStories.title: Define renown endgame contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want an explicit endgame contract so P81 knows exactly what flags, gates, events, and player-facing meanings must be closed — if endgame is worth doing.
acceptanceCriteria: Define endgame checkpoint, required flags, gate acceptance
Define endgame event structure (echo type, recommend auto with 3 variants)
Define stat changes (if any), identity marker, expression differences per branch
Define at least 2 endgame-specific player-facing signals
Clarify difference between endgame vs late-life vs generic P19 endgame echo
Preserve tavern-born flavor
Define age range (60-65? 65-70?)
If NO-GO, mark as skipped with rationale
Write contract to docs/PRD/p80-renown-endgame-contract.md
userStories.notes: Complete: Contract LOCKED — renown_endgame_echo auto event (age 60-65, 3 variants based on late-life branch, no stat changes, 6 expression surfaces, 3+ endgame signals, clear distinction from late-life and P19, tavern-born flavor, 5 reserved flags). 0 runtime changes.

userStories.title: Define P81 validation shape (if GO)
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the P81 validation shape fixed in advance so playable endgame work is judged against explicit proof and regression expectations — if endgame is worth doing.
acceptanceCriteria: Define targeted proof chain nodes (late-life → endgame → expression changes)
All 3 branches have core node verification
Define regression test minimum assertions
Define what evidence counts as endgame closed
No full lifetime exhaust required
Define no-regression boundary for P71/P72/P73/P75/P77/P79
If NO-GO, mark as skipped with rationale
userStories.notes: Complete: 7 core + 5 bonus proof nodes; ~22-27 regression tests across 7 groups; 9 closure criteria; no full lifetime exhaust; P71/P72/P73/P75/P77/P79 regression boundaries; implementation→validation mapping; lightweight compliance checks. 0 runtime changes.

userStories.title: Produce P80 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report that locks the renown endgame design-first contract and either hands off a bounded implementation target to P81 or explicitly stops the renown route at late-life.
acceptanceCriteria: Output docs/test-reports/p80-renown-endgame-closure-report.md
Summarize prerequisite audit, scope contract, endgame direction assessment, branch design (if GO), contract (if GO), validation shape (if GO)
Clarify boundary with P81 (if GO) or define stopping point (if NO-GO)
List deferred larger renown-expansion items
State whether endgame stage is worth implementing (GO / NO-GO)
If GO: state explicit lightweight constraint
If NO-GO: explain why renown route culminates at late-life and why that's better
userStories.notes: Complete: Closure report saved. 7/7 stories passed. CONDITIONAL_GO for P81 endgame implementation. Endgame direction: Legacy Echo (身后名之声) — 江湖如何记住你. 3 variants (叹/遥/传). Lightweight: 1 echo event + 6 expression updates, no stat changes. 0 runtime changes.
